title: Save the date for the sixth Presque Isle Art Fair - NewsBreak
text:
By Alexandria Bournonville ,
14 hours ago
MARQUETTE, Mich. (WBUP/WJMN) — The Presque Isle Art Fair is entering is sixth year with the latest event set for Saturday, June 27.
The art fair is a free, day-long arts festival showcasing local and regional artists' work. Presque Isle Art Fair was founded in 2020 in conjunction with Marquette Art Week, but has since grown into an independent event.
“The Presque Isle Art Fair is about more than art—it’s about celebrating the incredible creative community we have right here in the Upper Peninsula,” said the team at Niik Creative Co. “Every year we’re humbled by the talent our region has to offer, and we can’t wait to bring everyone together again on the shores of Lake Superior.”
Alongside a variety of art, visitors can expect an outdoor market with an array of handcrafted goods, specialty foods, and live music.
The fair will take place at Niik Creative Co., located at 2905 Island Beach Rd. in Marquette, on Saturday, June 27, from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m.
